Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6659); Sadoc (i.e. Tsadok), an Israelite:--Sadoc.
BiblicalUsage: Sadok is an Israelite in the genealogy of Jesus. You find the name in Matthew 1:14: "And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sadok matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
